title: Report-linked discussion tasks are classified as implementations
problem: The function treats every non-internal task with `signal_report_id` as an implementation task. The Tasks API also supports non-internal discussion and other report-linked tasks. Only real implementation tasks have the durable `relationship="implementation"` link. A PR from a discussion task can therefore bypass the standard bot, draft, review-mode, and permission gates.
suggestion: Check `Task.OriginProduct.SIGNAL_REPORT` and the durable implementation relationship before returning the DTO. Use `SignalReportTask.relationship == "implementation"` or the typed implementation artefact that existing Signals code uses. Return None for other report-linked tasks.
